sources.name: Quebec cadastre renovated-lot polygons (GO01_Polygones_Lots)
sources.scope: Quebec-wide generalized renewed-cadastre lot polygons; Montreal is an indicative entry area only, not a Montreal-specific layer. Geometry is indicative and has no legal value; some polygons may represent complementary plans. Additional enabled city entries have separate bounded qualification evidence; wider coverage remains unverified.
sources.licenceNote: Reuse terms are informational; integration is enabled based on verified public endpoint behavior. Preserve attribution and the indicative-only caveat.
